newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-STUTTGART CRASH TO SHOCK DEFEAT AT ST PAULI.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STUTTGART CRASH TO SHOCK DEFEAT AT ST PAULI.

text.p: VfB Stuttgart scorned the chance to push Bayern Munich from the top of the German first division when they lost 2-1 at lowly St Pauli on Saturday.
Midfielder Christian Springer struck both St Pauli goals while Stuttgart's feared striking force managed only a penalty, converted by Krasimir Balakov.
The defeat left the 1992 champions in second place on 27 points from 13 matches, one point behind Bayern.
As Stuttgart faltered, the pack took the opportunity to close the gap behind them.

Early season pacemakers Bayer Leverkusen joined them on 27 points with a 3-0 defeat of Borussia Moenchengladbach. Champions Borussia Dortmund were a further point behind after beating Schalke 3-1 away in the Ruhr district derby in Gelsenkirchen.
Bayern drew 1-1 with neighbours 1860 Munich on Friday.
